note: Unchanged from the 2026-05-08 assessment of the same prospect, and this call sharpens the income miss. He is a business owner whose health is the neglected area and who is not heavily overweight or gym-averse, but he is unambiguously at rescue rather than good-to-great, and on this call he attempted to negotiate the price down to $1,000 a month, said he needed to move money into the bank and clear credit cards before paying, and reported that his wife had called a $6,000 purchase crazy. That is a household for which this price is a stretch, not one where health is simply the underinvested corner of an otherwise well-resourced life.
